name: Walking Bulwark
oracle_text:
Defender
{2}: Until end of turn, target creature with defender gains haste, can attack as though it didn't have defender, and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {2}: Until end of turn, target creature with defender gains haste, can attack as though it didn't have defender, and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: a one-shot op with a duration (this_turn) under which the targeted creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power (rule 510.1a substitution), read by the combat-damage step and trample/lethal-assignment math; the timed counterpart of the Doran/Assault Formation static
needs.why_existing_wont_do: pump and set_pt change the creature's real power, which every other power read would see; replace_damage only scales or adds to damage already computed from power; nothing substitutes toughness for power at assignment, as a static or as an op

needs.what: a one-shot op with a duration (this_turn) letting the targeted creature attack as though it didn't have defender, while it keeps the defender keyword for everything else
needs.why_existing_wont_do: lose_keyword removes defender outright (the creature would stop matching 'creature with defender' filters and lose the keyword for other effects), and grant_keyword/must_attack do not lift the attack restriction; no op permits attacking despite defender
